movies.title: No Country for Old Men
movies.overview: Violence and mayhem ensue after a hunter stumbles upon the aftermath of a drug deal gone wrong and over two million dollars in cash near the Rio Grande.

movies.title: Weapons
movies.overview: When all but one child from the same class mysteriously vanish on the same night at exactly the same time, a community is left questioning who or what is behind their disappearance.

movies.title: The Witch: Part 1 - The Subversion
movies.overview: When a bright high school student with memory loss enters a national talent show to help her struggling family, she finds her ordinary life flipped upside down by the sudden arrival of mysterious strangers seemingly connected to her past.

movies.title: Sinners
movies.overview: Trying to leave their troubled lives behind, twin brothers return to their hometown to start again, only to discover that an even greater evil is waiting to welcome them back.

movies.title: Knives Out
movies.overview: When renowned crime novelist Harlan Thrombey is found dead at his estate just after his 85th birthday, the inquisitive and debonair Detective Benoit Blanc is mysteriously enlisted to investigate.

movies.title: The Killer
movies.overview: Solitary, cold, methodical and unencumbered by scruples or regrets, a killer waits in the shadows, watching for his next target. Yet, the longer he waits, the more he thinks he's losing his mind, if not his cool.

movies.title: Caddo Lake
movies.overview: When an 8-year-old girl disappears on Caddo Lake, a series of past deaths and disappearances begin to link together, altering a broken family's history.

movies.title: Little Miss Sunshine
movies.overview: A family determined to get their young daughter into the finals of a beauty pageant take a cross-country trip in their VW bus.

movies.title: The Secret Life of Walter Mitty
movies.overview: When both he and a colleague are about to lose their job, Walter takes action by embarking on an adventure more extraordinary than anything he ever imagined.
movies.requested_as: The Secret Life of Walter Mitty (2013)

movies.title: Chef
movies.overview: When Chef Carl Casper faces a career crisis, he hits the road to rediscover his passion for cooking.

movies.title: About Time
movies.overview: At the age of 21, Tim discovers he can travel in time and change what happens and has happened in his own life. His decision to make his world a better place by getting a girlfriend turns out not to be as easy as you might think.

movies.title: Pride & Prejudice
movies.overview: When Elizabeth Bennet meets the handsome Mr. Darcy, she believes he is the last man she could ever marry, but as their lives become intertwined, she finds herself captivated by the man she has sworn to hate forever.

movies.title: Little Forest
movies.overview: A young woman grows tired of life in the city and returns to her hometown in the countryside.

movies.title: Father Goose
movies.overview: During World War II, a man who's been persuaded to live on an isolated Pacific island and spot aircraft finds himself responsible for a teacher and several young female students.

movies.title: The Sting
movies.overview: Two grifters team up to pull off the ultimate con.

movies.title: Crocodile Dundee
movies.overview: An American reporter travels to the Australian outback to meet eccentric poacher Mick "Crocodile" Dundee and invites him to New York City, where he comes face-to-face with the complexities of modern life.

movies.title: Roxanne
movies.overview: The large-nosed C.D. Bales is in love with the beautiful Roxanne; she falls for his personality but another man's looks.

movies.title: The Secret of My Success
movies.overview: A talented young man can't get an executive position without rising through the ranks, so he comes up with a shortcut, which also benefits his love life.

movies.title: Willow
movies.overview: A young farmer is chosen to undertake a perilous journey in order to protect a special baby from an evil queen. Along the way, he teams up with a disgraced swordsman to defeat the evil sorceress.

movies.title: Joe Versus the Volcano
movies.overview: When a hypochondriac learns that he is dying, he accepts an offer to throw himself in a volcano at a tropical island, and along the way there, learns to truly live.

movies.title: Doc Hollywood
movies.overview: A young doctor on his way across the country to a job interview crashes his car in a small town and is sentenced to work for several days at the town hospital.

movies.title: Swingers
movies.overview: A wannabe actor has a hard time moving on from a break-up, but he is lucky to have supportive friends.

movies.title: Grosse Pointe Blank
movies.overview: Professional assassin Martin Blank is sent on a mission to a small Detroit suburb, Grosse Pointe--where, by coincidence, his 10-year high-school reunion party is about to take place.

movies.title: Edtv
movies.overview: A video store clerk agrees to have his life filmed by a camera crew for a television show.

movies.title: Mumford
movies.overview: In the small town of Mumford, a psychologist of the same name moves in and quickly becomes very popular, despite a questionable past.

movies.title: Love Actually
movies.overview: Follows the lives of eight very different couples in dealing with their love lives in various loosely interrelated tales all set during a frantic month before Christmas in London, England.

movies.title: Stranger Than Fiction
movies.overview: I.R.S. auditor Harold Crick suddenly finds his mundane Chicago life to be the subject of narration only he can hear: narration that begins to affect his entire existence, from his work to his love life to his death.

movies.title: The Longest Ride
movies.overview: Sophia and Luke make an unexpected and fateful connection with Ira, a 90-year-old man, when they save him from a car crash. Ira's memories of his own decades-long romance with his beloved wife deeply inspire the young couple.
